newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says '96 public sector deficit 1.2 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Peru says '96 public sector deficit 1.2 pct of GDP.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Friday the country's public sector deficit -- without taking into account income from the sale of state assets -- was the equivalent of 1.2 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in 1996, compared to 2.8 percent of GDP in 1995.
Peru's primary surplus was the equivalent of 1.1 percent of GDP, compared to 0.4 percent of GDP in 1995, the bank added in its weekly report.
The bank defines "primary surplus" as the difference between the government's spending, excluding interest payments on debt, and its income.
